questions.question: The Government of India recently stated that Left Wing Extremism (LWE) will be eliminated by 2026. What do you understand by LWE and how are the people affected by it? What measures have been taken by the government to eliminate LWE? (Answer in 150 words) [10 marks]

Indian government has recently strengthened the anti-terrorist laws by amending UAPA 1967 and NIA act. Analyze the changes in the context of prevailing security environment while discussing scope and the reasons for opposing UAPA by human rights organizations. (250 Words) (15 Marks)

questions.chapter: AFSPA: disturbed areas, security powers and accountability
questions.question: Human rights activists constantly highlight the view that the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958 (AFSPA) is a draconian act leading to cases of human rights abuses by the security forces. What sections of AFSPA are opposed by the activists? Critically evaluate the requirement with reference to the view held by the Apex Court.
